description: Unit tests for HKDF (HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation Function) implementation using Google Test framework, including test vectors from RFC 5869 and Wycheproof test vectors.

classes.name: HKDFTestVector
classes.description: Structure representing test vectors for HKDF, including hash function, input key material, salt, info, expected output, and lengths.

methods.name: TestVectors
methods.description: Test function that runs multiple HKDF test vectors, verifying correctness of HKDF extract, expand, and combined functions, as well as compatibility with OpenSSL API.

methods.name: WycheproofSHA1
methods.description: Test case that runs Wycheproof test vectors for HKDF with SHA-1.

methods.name: WycheproofSHA256
methods.description: Test case that runs Wycheproof test vectors for HKDF with SHA-256.

methods.name: WycheproofSHA384
methods.description: Test case that runs Wycheproof test vectors for HKDF with SHA-384.

methods.name: WycheproofSHA512
methods.description: Test case that runs Wycheproof test vectors for HKDF with SHA-512.
